about: The Physical Form table and what each body type does to a hero. roll is the d100 band as ruled; printed is what the book prints where they differ. column is the Random Ranks column. shift is column shifts; set is a fixed rank; choose_shift lets the player raise that many abilities (from: primary, or any including Resources and Popularity); powers changes the number of Powers; bonus_powers are Powers every hero of the type has, by code or by class. notes are short summaries the generator shows but does not compute. Where a type has variants, the variant's fields add to the type's.

types.name: Breed Mutant
notes: At least one Contact, usually the hero's tribe.

types.name: Android
notes: At least one Contact: whoever made the hero.

types.name: Humanoid Race
notes: Starts with exactly one Contact: the hero's race.

types.name: Surgical Composite
notes: Resistance to Mental Domination is -1CS.
Heals twice as fast as a Normal Human.
One Contact: whoever assembled the hero.

types.name: Modified Human (Organic)
notes: Heals twice as fast as a Normal Human.
At least one Contact: whoever did the modifying.

types.name: Modified Human (Muscular)
notes: At least one Contact: whoever did the modifying.

types.name: Modified Human (Skeletal)
notes: Resistance to physical attacks +1CS.
At least one Contact: whoever did the modifying.

types.name: Modified Human (Extra Parts)
notes: Extra arms: Fighting +1CS. Duplicate organs: double Health. Each tail: one more blunt attack. Wings: Flight.
At least one Contact: whoever did the modifying.

types.name: Centaur
notes: Moves four areas a turn on level ground and can fight with hooves.
Climbing is Feeble.

types.name: Equiman
notes: Kicks do +1CS damage.
Can pass for human with the legs and tail hidden.

types.name: Faun
notes: Feeble Mental Domination over human(oid) women.
Gains Popularity more slowly than other Demihumans.

types.name: Felinoid
notes: Excellent night vision.
Climbing +1CS.

types.name: Lupinoid
notes: Excellent sense of smell.
Popularity never drops below the one -1CS.

variants.name: Angelic Avian
notes: Wings from the shoulder blades.

variants.name: Harpy
notes: Arms double as wings; clawed bird legs; lays eggs.

types.name: Chiropteran
notes: Bat wings formed by the arms; hand-like feet; large ears.

types.name: Lamian
notes: A 50% chance of Excellent venom.
+1CS to escape bonds.

types.name: Merhuman
notes: Lungs and gills; dries out away from water; crawls on land.

types.name: Other Demihuman
notes: Any animal-human blend; the player and Judge set its traits.

types.name: Cyborg (Limbs and Organs)
notes: At least one Contact: the lab or hospital that built or maintains the hero.

types.name: Cyborg (Exoskeleton)
notes: An intact body inside a powered suit.

types.name: Cyborg (Mechanical Body)
notes: Monstrous resistance to disease and poison; vulnerable to magnetism and rust.
One Contact: the lab that built the hero.

types.name: Cyborg (Mechanically Augmented)
notes: Resources may be rolled instead of Good.

types.name: Robot (Humanshape)
notes: Weighs 500 to 2,000 pounds.
Self-repair stands in for Healing.

types.name: Robot (Usuform)
notes: Shaped by its Powers rather than like a person.

types.name: Robot (Metamorphic)
notes: Two or more forms, each with its own physical abilities.
Each form past two costs -1CS to every Primary Ability.

types.name: Robot (Computer)
notes: Immobile; acts through peripherals, starting with one robot.
Reduced resistance to electrical and magnetic attacks and to Phasing.

types.name: Angel or Demon
notes: A Psychological Weakness that negates the hero's Powers.

variants.name: Angel
notes: The Artifact Creation makes a magical sword of Excellent damage.

variants.name: Demon
notes: Invulnerable to heat and fire.

types.name: Deity
notes: Cannot truly die on Earth except at another deity's hand.
Surviving worshippers become Contacts.

types.name: Animal
notes: At least one human Contact, usually taken for the owner.

types.name: Vegetable
notes: Loses -1CS Strength and Endurance a day after three days without light and water.
No Contacts, unless science made the plant: then its maker may be one.

types.name: Abnormal Biochemistry
notes: Needs special food; anything that feeds on the hero takes Good damage.

types.name: Mineral Life
notes: Movement -1CS.
Immune to ordinary poisons and diseases.

types.name: Gaseous Life
notes: A natural Phasing through solids.

types.name: Liquid Life
notes: A natural Phasing through porous material.
No Contacts except the hero's own race, if there is one.

types.name: Energy Body
notes: Energy Control is an optional Power.
Resistance to Plasma Control is -1CS.
Touching the hero does Feeble damage.

types.name: Ethereal
notes: Fighting is Shift 0 on Earth except against another Ethereal.
Physical attacks -9CS.

types.name: Undead
notes: Powers negated within 10 feet of a religious symbol.
Needs a body-maintenance routine.

types.name: Compound
notes: Two to five body types at once, keeping some of each one's traits.
A Compound with any artificial body type is a Cyborg.

types.name: Changeling
notes: Two to five body types, one at a time; changing takes 10 turns.
Each form must have one Power no other form has.
A rolled Alter Ego may be discarded and rolled again.
